explication: NIXL is a modular library for accelerating point-to-point inference data transfers across CPU/GPU memory and storage. The principal workflow is an application using the C++ or Python API to describe buffers and request transfers; a plugin-backed engine performs the operation and exposes progress/status. The repository also includes metadata distribution, telemetry, and tracing. The README documents the plugin abstraction and optional ETCD coordination; sampled source confirms backend interfaces, plugin management, and selected engine behavior. Many plugin implementations were not sampled, so their connections are documented capabilities rather than inspected call paths.
